preconditions.description: The length of the array a is between 2 and 140582.
Each element of array b is between 0 and 187126.

postconditions.expression: output == 'YES' ==> len(a) == n and all(1 <= a_i <= 10**18 for a_i in a) and all(b_i == a_i % a[(i+1) % n] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', then there exists an array a of length n such that each a_i is between 1 and 10^18, and b_i = a_i % a[(i+1) % n] for all i.

postconditions.expression: output == 'NO' ==> not any(1 <= a_i <= 10**18 for a_i in a) or not all(b_i == a_i % a[(i+1) % n] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'NO', then there does not exist any array a of length n such that b_i = a_i % a[(i+1) % n] for all i.
